note: WAVE-A event-bounds gold cases (workstream Q, D-029 gate). Each case = a short window of a DEV corpus recording; runDir holds a WINDOWED people.json (frames filtered to the window, timestamps kept on the recording clock; see window-meta.json) so the completion bench's auto-target policy resolves the player the annotator verified. Labels are visual-truth only: annotator devin-visual-v2-wave-a looked at 12-60fps rendered frame sheets; every contactMs cites the bracketing frames in its note. Consumed by eventCompletionBench (event replay only - these runDirs have no report.json, so strokeBench/paddleBench ignore them by construction). SPLIT DISCIPLINE: all sessions here are DEV (afn-sasebo-2025-06, dvids-marne-2024, dvids-warriorgames-2026); no shadow/val/locked_test material was viewed or labeled.

ball-retrieval jog/kick between points - pickup motion, not a stroke
post-rally milling/ball-toss to server - not a hitting motion
